verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community remark praising SvelteKit's first-party "form actions" (svelte-comm-1), which points to integrated server-side form handling within the official ecosystem. SvelteKit is documented as Svelte's official app framework (svelte-docs-18), but nothing in the pack documents form actions or any validation module. missing for 10: first-party documentation of form actions or form-building APIs, any evidence of a first-party form validation module, detail on how forms integrate with Svelte reactivity, hands-on corroboration beyond a single comment.
